title: Watch Your Christmas Tree Get Recycled!
description:
Through our Christmas Tree Recycling Program, 22,031 Christmas trees were collected at 16 locations throughout the city this past holiday season!🌲♻️ Our Environmental Services team mulched them all, and now that mulch is helping with erosion control at the Greenery. Thank you, San Diego! 🙏 

Reminder: City residents can self-load up to two cubic yards of free mulch and compost from the Greenery: sandiego.gov/environmental-services/miramar/greenery/cmw 

#SanDiego #Christmas #Environment #recycle
